summary: Radware Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held May 25, 2026. Shareholders voted on and adopted all three proposals presented. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. No special-situation event such as a transaction, activist campaign, or management change is involved. This is a standard periodic report with no actionable deal terms, advisor recommendations, or risk-arb angle.
